title: LLM Alignment for the Arabs: A Homogenous Culture or Diverse Ones?

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative review and case analysis of existing Arabic instruction-tuning datasets (e.g., CIDAR) and cultural value alignment benchmarks (e.g., ACVA), analyzing multiple-choice questions and true/false statements to expose homogenizing cultural assumptions, regional exclusivity, and annotator-origin biases.

Evaluating dataset annotation practices and inter-annotator agreement metrics to demonstrate how randomly routing dialectal Arabic samples to annotators who do not speak those specific dialects leads to mislabeling (e.g., in hate speech and sarcasm detection) and disregards cultural nuances.
